contract.note: Reproducible gaps on human-manageable planning tasks fairly test the claimed absence of the full range of human competence. Neither universal model failure nor perfect human performance is required.

evidence.note: The contemporary planning study reports approximately 34% GPT-4 performance and an instructed human baseline of 39 valid plans among 50 participants, demonstrating a material planning gap.

reviews.rationale: The bounded planning evaluation establishes reproducible failures and a concrete human comparison within the relevant period. GPT-4's successes and improvements do not establish competence across all human-manageable tasks. This supports the limited denial of full human capability, without settling a comprehensive theory of intelligence.
